Subject: Quick tech screen before full demo

Hi Neha,

I signed up for Redwood's self-serve trial today and had a few quick technical questions before we schedule a full demo. We want a short 15-minute technical screen to confirm:
- whether Redwood can pin a model version for our workload,
- how data retention is handled for KV cache and logging,
- expected P95 latency for 2–3k token sequences on the recommended instance.

Would one of your SEs be available for a 15-min call early next week? We are based on Pacific time. Possible windows that work for us: Mon/Tue 10–12 PT or Wed 14–16 PT.

Thanks — I can share a brief requirements doc if helpful.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform Integrations
MarketLens
